segments.ja292:1.1: Bārāṇasyaṃ [bārāṇassaṃ (sī. pī.)] mahārāja, kākarājā nivāsako [nivāsiko (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja292:2.1: Tassa dohaḷinī bhariyā, suphassā bhakkhitumicchati [macchamicchati (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja292:3.1: Tesāhaṃ pahito dūto, rañño camhi idhāgato;
segments.ja292:3.3: Bhattu apacitiṃ kummi, nāsāyamakaraṃ [makariṃ (sī. nissaya)] vaṇanti.
